content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Use DLC stakeholder surveys and Cadmus research to confirm audience needs and design goals; review content/structure and recommend CMS, hosting and page/template requirements."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Prepare proposed audience-centered designs with modern navigation, homepage, graphic templates, icons, typography and SEO, preserving clear routes to products, technical requirements and application guidance."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Implement staff-editable WCMS templates and integrate the member portal and consistent QPL/AMS visual presentation without changing QPL or AMS functionality."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Provide non-product website search, organized/dynamic news, searchable blog content, social sharing and audience-engagement options, with website-activity analytics support including Google Analytics."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Provide responsive layouts and WCMS mobile previews/customization, and perform UX testing on all design elements."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Import applicable existing website content into the new site and perform the migration analysis, scripting, testing and coordination needed for that transition."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Provide encrypted system access over HTTPS and obtain service-level commitments from the WCMS OEM rather than only an implementation partner."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Provide staff training and detailed functionality documentation, plus support for questions and timely bug resolution during 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Eastern time."}]}
